The issuer appears to have adequate near-term liquidity (current ratio 1.44) and a meaningful retained earnings base, but the balance sheet is fairly leveraged, with liabilities representing roughly 78% of assets and equity covering only a modest portion of the capital structure. Positive EBIT and a reasonable operating margin support investment-grade quality, though the relatively weak asset coverage and leverage keep it in the lower BBB range.

DECISION: BBB-
